purchase-hold-placed.subject: Checkout paused for a buyer
purchase-hold-placed.title: A purchase hold was placed
purchase-hold-placed.summary: A buyer cancelled or let expire several unpaid orders, so their checkout is paused until {{until}}. Every cancellation was processed normally; nothing is blocked except placing a new order. The pause ends by itself; place a manual hold on the account to keep it longer.

outcome-unknown.subject: Check the result: {{operation}} on {{subjectName}}
outcome-unknown.title: A write began and never reported how it ended
outcome-unknown.summary: The {{operation}} on {{subjectName}} (started {{since}}) began and the server never reported how it ended. It was not run again, so money or stock may or may not have moved. Open the screen, check the result, and only then act again; a repeat with a new key is a new write.
